summary: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register up to 920,000 shares of Class A common stock for issuance under customer acquisition promotions. The offering is promotional; the company will not receive cash proceeds, and shares are newly issued or sourced from treasury/open-market purchases. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine securities registration for promotional share distribution. Trading price on July 29, 2026 was $86.26. Terms are not disclosed beyond share count and promotional nature. Watch for potential dilution from new share issuance as promotions are executed.
